name: recipe-engine
description: Deterministic, verified, zero-token replay of desktop and browser workflows Claude has already done once (Windows host over loopback MCP).

token.title: Engine token
token.description: Contents of %LOCALAPPDATA%\RecipeEngine\token on the Windows PC that runs the host (printed by `recipe-engine token`).

url.title: Engine URL
url.description: http://127.0.0.1:47391/mcp on the host itself. If Cowork's sandbox cannot reach the host's loopback, start the host with --bind <adapter IP> and put that URL here (the token is still required).
